title: Quickstart screenshot capture orchestration: automated redaction, crop presets, and locale-safe exports
creator: Ethan Rivera
description: Goal: Ship a repeatable, brand-consistent pipeline that converts in-app quickstart flows and console screens into production-ready screenshot assets used by docs, release notes, and onboarding emails. The pipeline must: (1) capture high-fidelity frames from the latest UI, (2) apply deterministic cropping and padding presets per layout family, (3) redact or replace PII and volatile tokens with brand-safe placeholders, and (4) produce locale-safe variants (strings replaced or layered) without manual rework.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline can consume a URL or Figma frame identifier and emit PNG/SVG assets at specified presets (hero, thumbnail, mobile)
Automated redaction rules detect and mask emails, API keys, user IDs, and sample text flagged in the DOM; masks are brand-approved (rounded rectangle + neutral fill) rather than blurred
Crop presets (hero, 16:9 banner, mobile card) preserve focal UI elements and apply consistent 24px brand padding
Locale-safe export produces one canonical UX layout per locale with either (a) text overlays sourced from i18n strings or (b) placeholder tokens replaced, as configured
Artifacts include metadata JSON alongside each image listing source_frame, preset, locale, commit_sha, and author for traceability
Integration tests in CI validate that screenshot generation for the quickstart flow completes under 30s per screen and matches visual regression baselines within 0.3% pixel diff threshold
tasks: Define capture recipe and naming conventions (lead: design)
Draft redaction spec with regexes and DOM heuristics (lead: security + design)
Create crop presets library and example wireframes in Figma (lead: design)
Prototype a CLI/tooling wrapper that calls the capture service and applies post-processing filters (eng collaboration)
Add locale overlay support: map i18n keys to export layers (collab with i18n team)
Add CI job that regenerates assets on release branch and uploads to docs bucket
QA pass with engineering: run on staging UIs and iterate on false positives for redaction
decisions: Use visible masks (solid rounded rectangles with 8px radius) instead of blur for redaction to avoid accidental information leaks in compression and to maintain accessibility contrast
Export both masked and synthetic-user variants when feasible: masked for public docs, synthetic for internal demos and sales decks
Adopt Figma as the single source-of-truth for layout presets and store capture recipes as a JSON manifest in the repo
Deterministic cropping will prefer UI-affinity anchors: navigation bar > primary card > footer, to reduce manual adjustments across releases

review_feedback: Priya Shah (PM): prefer placeholder text like 'example@company.com' for internal variants; public docs should be masked.
Liam O'Connor (Eng): capture API should return DOM snapshot + screenshot; otherwise redaction heuristics are unreliable across browsers.
Security: require a checklist for regex updates; any change to redaction rules must include test vectors and a runbook
